name: Volumetric Isosurface Rendering with Intersection Refinement
aliases: iso surface/volume rendering by volume raycasting
definition: A rendering mode that extracts an isosurface directly from volume data during ray traversal by stopping when the sampled value exceeds an isovalue, using intersection refinement to reduce discretization artifacts.
summary: Volumetric Isosurface Rendering with Intersection Refinement is a real-time technique that extracts isosurfaces directly from 3D scalar fields during ray traversal, refining intersection positions to reduce artifacts and stopping at the first hit for higher performance than compositing methods.
